correctness.rationale: The current primary source gives the exact common presentation and identifies which generator is meridional for each knot. The only m-dependent word is a power of yx. Since A5 has exponent 30, the constrained homomorphism counts are exactly periodic modulo 30. Exhaustive evaluation of all 30 residues and all 3600 remaining generator assignments on each side gives (6,1) exactly for residues 1 modulo 3 and (1,1) otherwise. The source's peripheral invariance proposition converts unequal counts into the stated obstruction, while its trace and Alexander-polynomial propositions supply the remaining conclusions.

value.rationale: The source itself uses the A5 count to establish the key distinction between same-trace knots and then restricts its explicit infinite family to m=60l+1. Determining the exact residue support of that same obstruction is a natural completeness question. The result enlarges the certified parameter set from density 1/60 to density 1/3, while also locating exactly where this witness becomes inconclusive; this materially sharpens the source theorem rather than adding an arbitrary computation.
